reviews.title: Good Product
reviews.comment: This has been working pretty well for me. Great adjustability, and the design is sleek. It's also quite sturdy and doesn't move around too much. I had to get an adapter for the desk attachment part, as it was too small for my desk, but it's still a good product.
reviews.author: Nia

reviews.title: Very strong
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1RL+Tf82nL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61a60y1U6jL._SY256.jpg Great mic arm at an affordable price! I've been using the InnoGear Mic Arm for a while now and it has exceeded my expectations. It's sturdy, easy to adjust, and holds the mic in the desired position without falling or loosening over time.
The clamping base is strong and grips any desk well without damaging it. Additionally, the arm is flexible yet firm, allowing it to be positioned at different angles without issues. I've used it with heavy microphones and it supports them perfectly.
It includes a universal adapter, making it compatible with most microphones. It also comes with a pop filter and shock mount, which is a nice extra for the price.
If you're looking for a durable, stable, and affordable mic arm, the InnoGear Mic Arm is a great choice. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Edy

reviews.title: Boom Mic For Blue Yeti! (But not for Blue Yeti)
reviews.comment:
Update:
Apparently the mounting was just missing. I got a refund for that and got an adapter on my own dime. After using for a few weeks, the quality is still fair. Its not the most stable but definitely fair for the price and it stays in place. I would recommend buying a shock mount for your mic if the included one doesn’t fit.
Item description says it's for Blue Yeti, but literally has no parts that allow you to use it with blue yeti. The Shock mount is too small and it doesn't come with an adapter. The quality is cheap but appropriate for the cost.
reviews.author: Karina & George

reviews.title: Amazing,Sturdy, Mic for ALL MICS!
reviews.comment: i was not expecting for this to be this sturdy!it feels very well built and feels expensive. the pop filter feels so well made and so does the actual mic holder and arm. no instructions though but its really easy to figure out by looking at the pic. this has a piece  to attach any mic , and even comes with a troubleshooting guide. i got one for 30$ at guitar center and this EASILY is better quality. just get this mic and i guarantee you will be pleasantly surprised. i have a home studio and im upgrading my equipment to start a new chapter, and i wanted my setup to look good, and feel sturdy and not cheap. this did perfectly! you can even customize it for when your standing and sitting on the same surface. (if your short-ish) For this cheap just get it, your not getting any better for this price, or even for 20$ more.

reviews.title: Great Value Mic Arm with a Solid Grip
reviews.comment: This stand is exactly what I needed. It's lightweight, easy to adjust, and the "flex arms" are very functional without taking up too much space. The vise grip stays steady on my desk, and the mic holder is compatible with every microphone I’ve tried. Great entry-level gear that gets the job done.
